_note: English. Keys must match tr.json exactly - tests/test_lang.py enforces this. A missing key falls back to Turkish and is reported, never silently blank.
_style: Strings are stored AS DISPLAYED. Headings are written in capitals here rather than uppercased at runtime (see i18n.py).

character.heading: WHO WILL YOU PLAY?
character.echo_rey_2: Makes hidden passages glow, gives hints
character.echo_rey_cost: The cost: the screen darkens, sound muffles, defence drops.
character.echo_rey_loss: Dying drops one tier. It never falls below Silent.
character.echo_title_ardo: NO ECHO  ·  he fights in silence
character.echo_ardo_1: No help: no enemies revealed, no hints
character.echo_ardo_2: More health, heavier blows, tighter combo
character.echo_ardo_3: Rey's hardest tier is Ardo's normal
character.echo_ardo_cost: In return: chapters cleared without Echo pay more.
character.echo_ardo_loss: Dying does not change how Ardo plays.

settings.heading: SETTINGS
settings.screen_shake_note: Turn it off if you feel motion sick.
settings.brightness_note: The game is dark - tune it to your screen.
settings.volume_echo_note: Separate channel - turn it down if it unsettles you.
settings.echo_penalty_note: When off, dying does not lower your Echo tier.
settings.auto_combo_note: When on, one button carries the chain.
settings.postfx_note: Edge darkening and per-chapter colour tone. Off shows the raw scene.
settings.gamepad_note: Off starts instantly. Turning it on scans for pads; can be slow.

line.ch01_cemo_gift: I made this for you... Maybe it'll make the darkness think twice.
line.ch01_rey_thanks: Thank you, Cemo. I'll keep it with me.
line.ch01_echo_first: Wake up... The dark is already awake.
line.ch01_echo_rift: Something below is waiting for you...
line.ch01_echo_alone: You want them back... don't you?
line.ch01_echo_sword: Take it. Even the dark knows steel.
line.ch01_echo_wall: Do you feel it? The veil is thin here.
line.ch02_echo_wall: Listen... Something is still breathing beneath the stone.
line.ch02_echo_secret: Someone searched for this secret before you... then their voice went silent.
line.ch02_echo_boss: This creature was waiting for you... as if it knew you would come.
line.ch02_rey_claw2: These marks... They fought until the end.
line.ch02_echo_fall: Good... Let yourself fall. The darkness will carry you.
line.ch01_echo_gift: We lend you our sight... for now.
line.ch01_ardo_thanks: Thank you, kid. This might keep me alive.
line.ch01_ardo_rift: I've seen a wound like this before. Even the stone was torn from within.
line.ch01_ardo_alone: I know what lies below. I won't leave them in that darkness.
line.ch02_ardo_boss: Time changed it. The darkness fed on what remained.
line.ch02_ardo_exit: The trail goes deeper. They took them beyond this place.
line.ch02_ardo_secret: Someone came through here before. There are no tracks leading back.
line.ch02_ardo_claw2: Claw marks... They fought until the very end.
line.ch03_echo_enter: Even our sight cannot pierce this darkness. We need a spark.
line.ch03_ardo_enter: The darkness is thick here. We won't get far without fire.
line.ch03_echo_keeper: It isn't looking at me... It recognizes you.
line.ch03_ardo_keeper: It's not preparing to attack. It wants something.
line.ch03_echo_purple: Yes... This flame feeds more than us.
line.ch03_ardo_purple: This flame isn't natural. It's burned the same way for centuries.
line.ch03_echo_boss: This vessel once carried light... now only the shell remains.
line.ch03_ardo_boss: The light inside it is gone. Only a rotting shell remains.
line.ch04_echo_enter: Life went silent here long ago.
line.ch04_ardo_enter: No blood here. Only signs of someone waiting.
line.ch04_echo_camp: They went down too... and never came back.
line.ch04_ardo_camp: They stopped here. They must have sensed something ahead.
line.ch04_echo_map: The missing part... is the place the map was afraid to show.
line.ch04_ardo_map: They finished half the map. They never lived to draw the rest.
line.ch04_echo_exit: You've waited long enough. The path is waiting.
line.ch04_ardo_exit: We're too deep to stop now.
line.ch05_ardo_enter: The dungeons are flooded. Most of the mechanisms have rusted shut.
line.ch05_echo_valve: Turn it... Water can open a path. Or become a grave.
line.ch05_ardo_valve: An old valve. If it still works, we can redirect the water.
line.ch05_echo_guard: This is more than a corpse... something inside is still awake.
line.ch05_ardo_guard: An old guardian. The darkness brought it back.
line.ch05_echo_block: It trusts its shield. That's its weakness.
line.ch05_ardo_block: The shield is heavy. Don't fight it from the front. Get behind it.
line.ch06_rey_plates: Two plates... Someone has to hold the other one.
line.ch06_ardo_plates: Two plates. One person won't be enough.
line.ch06_rey_arena: This thing isn't like the others...
line.ch06_ardo_arena: This one leaves no trail. It came from nowhere — it grew here.
line.prologue_rey_1: They're back... The whispers in my head. Voices no one else can hear.
line.prologue_echo_2: They cannot hear us. Only you can.
line.prologue_rey_2: Is that why the villagers feared me? They gave me a single name... Cursed.
line.prologue_echo_3: People fear what they cannot understand.
line.prologue_rey_3: Sometimes I hate you... And sometimes, I'm afraid of losing you.
line.prologue_rey_6: I can see what's behind the wall.
line.prologue_echo_11: Because fear senses what is coming before anyone else.
line.prologue_ardo_1: I hear no whispers. I read the traces they leave behind.
line.prologue_ardo_5: I won't leave them down there.
line.prologue_echo_5b: Beyond the flesh... behind the stone... the truth hidden in the shadows.
line.ch07_rey_seal: A seal... Someone shut this door. From the inside.
line.ch07_ardo_seal: A guardian seal. Whatever is down there locked itself in.
line.ch07_rey_door: The door won't open. But the wall is cracked — there's a gap.
line.ch07_ardo_door: This door won't open from here. The lever must be on the far side.
line.ch07_rey_alone: I'm on the other side. The voices are still with me... but he isn't.
line.ch07_ardo_alone: She's through. This time I'm the one waiting.
line.ch06_meet_ardo_first: All three were behind you. You never watch your back.
line.ch06_meet_ardo_name: Ardo. And I'm not the only thing that came down this far.
line.ch06_meet_rey_first: All three were behind you. You didn't even hear one of them.
line.ch06_meet_rey_name: Rey. I'm looking for my brother — and the voices knew you'd be here.
line.ch08_fire_ardo_wound: My shoulder. Caught a rock on the way down — it's nothing.
line.ch08_fire_rey_wound: My shoulder. Caught a rock on the way down — it's nothing.
line.ch08_fire_rey_necklace: Cemo gave me this. So the dark would think twice.
line.ch08_fire_ardo_necklace: There's no one waiting up there. That made coming down easy.
line.ch08_fire_ardo_teach: Not shouting. You find the stone's own pitch.
line.ch08_fire_rey_learn: The voices in my head already knew that. They never told me.
line.ch08_echo_ardo: He was called down too... but the thing calling him isn't the one you hear.
line.ch08_echo_rey_react: Be quiet. I didn't ask you about him.
line.ch08_trace_ardo: There's a second trail behind hers. Not following — waiting.
line.ch08_trace_ardo_react: I won't tell her. Not yet.
line.ch08_rey_learn: That crystal... it's humming. Like it's waiting for something.
line.ch08_ardo_learn: The crystal holds sound. It breaks at the right pitch.
line.ch08_rey_gate: The way's blocked. And I can't reach the lever.
line.ch08_ardo_gate: The latch is behind the wall. Our hands won't reach — our voice will.
line.ch09_rey_tower: A tower... and it's hollow. Three bells hanging up there.
line.ch09_ardo_tower: A bell tower. The top has fallen in — and there were never any stairs.
line.ch09_rey_top: The fresco was right. That was the order.
line.ch09_ardo_top: The door recognised the sound. Right order.
line.ch09_trust_offer_ardo: You can't make that jump. Use my hands as a step — I'll lift you.
line.ch09_trust_offer_rey: You can't make that jump. Use my hands as a step — I'll lift you.
line.ch09_trust_accept_rey: All right. You won't let go, will you?
line.ch10_part_ardo: The path splits. I'll take the left, you take the right.
line.ch10_part_rey: The path splits. I'll take the left, you take the right.
line.ch10_echo_rises: He's gone. You hear me more clearly now, don't you?
line.ch10_trace_rises: Her trail goes left. Mine turns right.
line.ch10_rey_alone: Alone. The voices are louder than they've ever been.
line.ch10_ardo_alone: Alone. Familiar — but it doesn't sit right any more.
line.ch10_rey_after: I won't take the way that voice points to again.
line.ch10_ardo_after: Trails don't lie. But someone can leave one.
line.ch10_echo_lure: Up there. The way is clear — trust me, it always was.
line.ch10_trace_lure: The trail points up. Fresh, clear, inviting.
line.ch10_echo_ignored: ...Down there? Fine. Have it your way.
line.ch10_trace_ignored: That trail is too clean. Nobody walks that neatly.
line.ch10_lie_sprung: The floor was rotten. I couldn't have known.
line.ch10_lie_sprung_react: Couldn't you? You see through stone.
line.ch10_lie_survived: See? You made it. I'm never wrong.
line.ch10_lie_survived_react: The floor gave way. It nearly took me with it.
line.ch10_lie_ignored: You didn't listen. You took the long way and tired yourself.
line.ch10_lie_ignored_react: But I got here. On my own feet.
line.ch10_lie_neutral: Here you are. How you got here doesn't matter.
line.ch10_trace_sprung: A false trail. Someone faked a walk here — and cut the floor.
line.ch10_trace_survived: The floor gave way. That trail was left there for a reason.
line.ch10_trace_ignored_after: I read it right. That trail was too clean.
line.ch10_trace_neutral: Another trail. I look at all of them twice now.
line.ch11_rey_hall: Mirrors... and I'm not in any of them.
line.ch11_ardo_hall: A hall of mirrors. Everyone who came through left a trail — none of them left.
line.ch11_rey_mirror: The light turns off the mirror. I can rotate it.
line.ch11_ardo_mirror: The mirror turns. I can send the light where I want.
line.ch11_echo_lie: The middle one is wrong. Turn it — that's what breaks the chain.
line.ch11_trace_lie: Fresh fingerprints on the middle mirror. Someone turned it at the last moment.
line.ch11_rey_doubt: That's what you said last time, too.
line.ch11_ardo_doubt: A fresh trail doesn't mean a true one.
line.ch13_rey_lever: A lever. And beyond it, iron coming down.
line.ch13_ardo_lever: Lever, gate, timer. Someone counted who passed here.
line.ch13_rey_run: It closes if I stop. So I won't stop.
line.ch13_ardo_run: A fight costs time. I don't have any.
line.ch13_ardo_mark: A child stood here and cut something into the wall.
line.ch13_echo_cage: You see. He's alive. Now you'll come down faster.
line.ch13_trace_cage: He's alive. Knowing that doesn't make it easier.
line.ch13_rey_sign: He left it for me. He marked the way.
line.ch13_ardo_sign: He tried to run. And hurt someone trying.
line.ch13_echo_blood: The blood isn't fresh. His fear is.
line.ch13_trace_blood: The chain broke, not the lock. So he pulled.
line.ch13_echo_gaoler: There. The one this room belongs to. He never sets down the lantern.
line.ch13_trace_gaoler: Keys on his belt. So he's the one who opens the door.
line.ch13_rey_gaoler: Where did you take my brother?
line.ch13_ardo_gaoler: Give me the keys. I'm offering the easy way once.
line.ch13_echo_deeper: Below. It was always below. You're close to where you hear me now.
line.ch13_trace_deeper: The tracks go down. This time they don't come back.
line.ch12_mark_arrow: An arrow. Right. He drew it for me.
line.ch12_mark_arrow_ardo: A footprint. He stood here and looked both ways — he didn't know the road.
line.ch12_mark_cache: Supplies. He split his share and left mine.
line.ch12_mark_cache_ardo: He never touched the food I left. Missed it, or was ashamed to take it.
line.ch12_mark_camp: He slept here. Kept the fire small — he didn't want to be seen.
line.ch12_mark_camp_ardo: He didn't sleep here. Sat down, got up, sat down again.
line.ch12_mark_count: Notches. He was counting the days.
line.ch12_mark_count_ardo: Notches on the wall. His hand shook while he counted.
line.ch12_mark_pencil: A broken piece of charcoal. It snapped while he was drawing.
line.ch12_mark_pencil_ardo: Charcoal dust. He drew something, then tried to rub it out.
line.ch12_mark_figure_ardo: He drew me. Rough, rushed — but he got the eyes right.
line.ch12_keeper: You again. Your candles have burned down.
line.ch12_keeper_ardo: One candle fewer every time I come down. What happens after the last one?
line.ch12_cine_fire: The fire's out but the ash is still warm. He was here moments ago.
line.ch12_cine_fire_ardo: The ash is warm. He waited for me and gave up.
line.ch12_cine_pack: The pack is open. He split what was inside in two.
line.ch12_cine_pack_ardo: He opened the pack, went through it, took nothing.
line.ch12_echo_rig: This took time to build. He had no time to wait — but time to build.
line.ch12_trace_rig: The rig is solid. He didn't rush it — so whoever came down wouldn't fall.
line.ch12_letter_all: I saw all of it. He was writing to me the whole way down.
line.ch12_letter_all_ardo: I saw all of it. Not once did he write that he was alone.
line.ch12_letter_some: I saw some of it. The rest stayed up there.
line.ch12_letter_some_ardo: I saw some of it. I came down too fast.
line.ch12_letter_few: I came down too fast. I left things behind me.
line.ch12_letter_few_ardo: I didn't look. I thought I had no time to look.
line.ch12_after_all: We'll meet down there. He didn't promise — I did.
line.ch12_after_all_ardo: We'll meet down there. This time I won't be late.
line.ch12_after_some: I can't go back. Up there is closed now.
line.ch12_after_some_ardo: No going back. Whatever's below is what there is.
line.ch12_echo_deeper: You're going down. Good. I'm down there too.
line.ch12_trace_deeper: The tracks end here. What comes next is mine.
